# sherpa-file-upload

Drag-and-drop file zone; "browse" triggers the hidden &lt;input type="file">.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | File Uploader |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-file-upload/sherpa-file-upload.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-file-upload/sherpa-file-upload.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-file-upload/sherpa-file-upload.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-file-upload/sherpa-file-upload.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-file-upload/sherpa-file-upload.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-file-upload data-label="Attach a contract" data-description="PDF only" accept="application/pdf" data-max-size="5MB"></sherpa-file-upload>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accept` | text |  | comma-separated MIME types / extensions → native accept + hint |
| `data-description` | text |  | helper text under the list (hidden when empty) |
| `data-label` | text |  | label above the drop zone (hidden when empty) |
| `data-loading` | boolean |  | in-flight state (disables the upload button) |
| `data-max-size` | text |  | maximum file-size hint (e.g. "4 MB") shown in details |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | disabled state |
| `multiple` | boolean, native | `false` | allow selecting more than one file → native multiple |
| `name` | text, native |  | the form field its files are submitted under |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | `File[]` | read only |  |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset empties it, as a native file input. |
| `setFileStatus(index: number, status: string)` | Set a per-file status line (e.g. "Uploading…", "Uploaded", "Failed"). |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `file-add` | `{ added: File[]; files: File[] }` |
| `file-remove` | `{ files: File[]; removed: File }` |
| `file-clear` |  |
| `file-upload-start` | `{ files: File[] }` |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `actions` | control | extra controls in the actions row (before clear/upload) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`actions`, `allowed-types`, `browse`, `clear-all`, `details`, `drop-zone`, `field`, `file-list`, `file-status`, `helper`, `label`, `max-size`, `upload`
